title: Felt Cognition: Parallel Micro-Eddies, the Stream of Thought, and the Open Problem of Experience
paper_class: frontier (model + large open register; no causal anchor)
abstract: A functional model of the stream of thought on the verified neuro chain. A thought is many parallel ionic eddies igniting in γ (winner-take-most); the basal-ganglia loop selects one; a dopamine error shapes which eddies are laid down next; serial selection bound within a θ frame is the stream. The 'field' is band-structured phase-coherence on ionic spikes and synaptic currents (CTC), not a physical field. The embodied real-time loop is proposed as felt cognition; whether it is experience is open. No link is causal; the hard problem is deferred, not solved.
headline_results: the stream of thought = serial selection among parallel γ-eddies (functional model)
the 'field' = band-structured phase-coherence on ionic spikes/synaptic currents (CTC) — NOT the retired EM field
consciousness (PCI access marker) = honest negative; the hard problem is OPEN — function specified, not experience
thinking ≠ feeling: a system can compute the stream yet lack the embodied real-time loop (architectural hypothesis)

inter-organ ephaptic coordination = partial/metastable at MEASURED coupling (kappa=0.55); field causally contributes (cancel-vs-augment in silico), carries CTC + theta-gamma PAC + traveling waves [V mechanism]; biological functional use OPEN

sensory inflow = eight streams (nine modalities) coupled to anatomical central relays at the SAME measured kappa=0.55; input loads onto the central field without seizing (anchor R = frozen M9); cross-modal binding rides ONLY the shared field (cancel<measured<augment, co-relay control flat) [V mechanism]; functional use OPEN — closes data-gate (c)
dependency: one-way: mind cites neuro; neuro does not depend on mind

chapters.title: Constitution and scope
chapters.one_liner: What this paper reads (the functional stream of thought, present-tense), the physical-mediator discipline, the one-way dependency on neuro, and the hard problem held open.

chapters.title: The retired field, and what replaces it
chapters.one_liner: The earlier EM field, the coherence-length rejection (corrected — it was the quantum case; the classical field is coherent across the brain, so its medium role is open), and the named mechanism that replaces it: ion spikes and synaptic currents, gated by classified low-frequency phase (CTC). Locked by regime: EM is never retired wholesale — only the radiative far-field/optical-fibre carrier is; the near-field/ephaptic form is affirmed at threshold (neuro §18–§19), with only its functional use open (EM_NEAR_FAR_THESIS.md).

chapters.title: Brain organs from 4D-DNA
chapters.one_liner: The substrate is emerged, not assumed: each organ's master gene sets a measured bistable γ, and from γ alone the engine predicts the commit order — hypothalamus, cerebellum, cerebrum, hippocampus. Absolute size stays open.

chapters.title: The EM brainwave, emerged
chapters.one_liner: Excitatory and inhibitory populations make a theta–gamma local field radiated through the wave equation; the emitted front travels at the wave speed c and the field is coherent across the brain, so the old coherence-length rejection (a quantum number) fails. Whether it is the computational medium turns on field strength and stays open.

chapters.title: How memory remembers
chapters.one_liner: Memory is a physical attractor: a Hebbian write deepens an engram cell's well until it completes from a tenth of a cue; the theta brainwave is the clock, and writing and retrieving on opposite phases measurably protects old memory.

chapters.title: Parallel micro-eddies
chapters.one_liner: A thought is many local ionic γ-assemblies laid down in parallel; the competition is winner-take-most, γ sets ignitability, and absolute size and consciousness are open.

chapters.title: Selection: the closed loop
chapters.one_liner: Among the parallel eddies, one is selected by the basal-ganglia action-selection loop of the neuro chain; the carried (most-ignited) eddy wins, γ predicts the delay.

chapters.title: The laid-down field is learned
chapters.one_liner: Which eddies get laid down is itself learned: a selection outcome makes a dopamine reward-prediction error that updates which eddies appear next — the system learns what to think.

chapters.title: The stream of thought
chapters.one_liner: The stream is serial selection — one eddy then the next, with conflict, memory feedback, and a global γ synchrony binding the contents; the 'large field' is θ–γ phase-coherence.

chapters.title: The embodied feeling loop
chapters.one_liner: Body and brain form one loop; the real-time feeling loop proposes consciousness is this integrated eddy process — but whether the loop is experience, or only correlates with it, is open.

chapters.title: Hemispheres, and why thought is not feeling
chapters.one_liner: Hemispheric asymmetry is graded, not the folk myth; and a system can run the stream's computation yet lack the embodied real-time loop and experience — an architectural hypothesis.

chapters.title: The open problem of experience
chapters.one_liner: The standing reference: the honest negative on the access marker, the open register (access, the hard problem, the quale), and the irreversible retired register.

chapters.title: Inter-organ coordination by the ephaptic field
chapters.one_liner: Eight brain organs, each with a measured master-gene identity and a cited rhythm, coupled only by the measured ephaptic near-field (~1/r^3, at the entrainment threshold; neuro 18-19), settle into partial, metastable coordination. The cancel-vs-augment test run in silico shows the field causally contributes coordination, opens CTC windows, carries theta-gamma PAC, and supports a traveling wave [verified mechanism]; whether cognition uses it is open.

chapters.title: Sensory inflow — what the measured field binds
chapters.one_liner: Eight sensory streams covering the nine modalities (one skin organ carries touch, warmth and high-threshold pain), each with a master-gene identity read verbatim from the neuro chain and a cited rhythm, couple to their anatomical central relay at the SAME measured ephaptic strength (kappa=0.55, no new constant). Sensory drive loads onto the central field without seizing it (anchor R unchanged = frozen M9); distinct senses bind cross-modally only through that shared field (cancel < measured < augment, co-relay control flat) [verified mechanism]; whether cognition uses it is open.

chapters.title: Light to memory — how emerged light writes an engram
chapters.one_liner: On the same vacuum lattice a brainwave is emerged light; brainwave and sensory EM superpose, and geometric angle rectification (alpha = 2/pi single, delta = 1/pi^2 double, with 2*pi = alpha/delta) turns their signed, self-cancelling phase overlap into a sign-surviving information bit. A bound pair rectifies to 1/4, an unbound pair to the floor delta; the contrast clears the R19 engram fold and writes a persisting memory under a theta write-clock. Six informations roll through gamma slots in one theta frame, all recovered, and a downstream neuron feels the rolled field. Verified in-silico mechanism; biological use stays open.

chapters.title: What a thought is — the definition that closes the paper
chapters.one_liner: The closing chapter defines the paper's central word. A thought is the union of fourteen mental faculties, not an abstract umbrella; mechanically, serial selection among parallel ionic gamma-eddies bound within a theta frame, running on a substrate emerged from 4D-DNA (organs, brainwave and memory generated, not assumed). The everyday felt stream is recovered as a fast chain of discrete selections. Closed on the mechanism axis; whether any of it is felt is a separate, orthogonal question left open.

chapters.title: The faculties of mind — thought decomposed into fourteen faculties
chapters.one_liner: The atlas behind the closing definition. Thought is partitioned into fourteen faculties: ten (perception, attention, the serial stream, memory, learning, the affect mechanism, arousal/sleep, dreaming, large-scale binding, pathology) are built, frozen and bit-reproducible; four (language, volition, social cognition, metacognition) are honestly owed with named external inputs. The partition is run against the standard neurocognitive domains so it cannot be gerrymandered, and the dream worked example shows why thought is the umbrella and cognition one room under it. Closed on the mechanism axis; the felt axis stays orthogonal.

chapters.title: Autism as a three-axis fault — threshold, gain, and wiring
chapters.one_liner: Autism read on the emerged cerebrum as three separable faults — a threshold/E-I fault (T), an output/gain fault (O), and a long-range wiring fault (W). The pair (ΔPAC, ignition fold) uniquely fingerprints each and reproduces under SEED=19. Which fault any individual's autism is, is held open. efficacy=0; not a diagnosis.

chapters.title: What a chemical can and cannot reach — mask versus correction
chapters.one_liner: On the three-axis model, a scalar threshold-lowering (gain) chemical — the stimulant-class mechanism — fully reverses the T fault, partly helps O, and only masks W by over-synchronisation, because scalar gain cannot re-route geometry. The engine's account of why a stimulant relieves some autism and not others. efficacy=0; no drug-treats-autism claim.

chapters.title: The θ-cap — an external pacemaker for the wiring axis
chapters.one_liner: The keystone disorder chapter. On the wiring-faulted cohort only a coherence-forcing external clock routes (inj 0.08–0.10; over-sync past 0.15); every passive additive lane is inert, so the benign-lane reframing is refuted. The cap is cleanly removable (no plasticity, no dependence) and molecularly safe below the spinodal fold — a pacemaker, not a repair.

chapters.title: The θ-cap operating principle — and whether it is physically buildable
chapters.one_liner: If a θ-cap is to supply the wiring-axis function at all, the dynamics force one mode: minimum-effective, deficit-matched amplitude, applied continuously — nothing is banked. Paired with a physical-feasibility review: every component (theta-tACS, closed-loop phase-locking, multi-electrode long-range montages) exists today, the specific assembly does not, and feasibility is not benefit. efficacy=0.

chapters.title: ADHD — and why it separates from autism
chapters.one_liner: An explicit gene-grounded ADHD substrate (six gain/output genes, two arousal/threshold genes, wiring=none) emerged on the same engine. A stimulant restores ADHD to health where it only partly reaches autism; the cap is 3.3× more wiring-selective; on an AuDHD substrate the two compose without interference. Why severe ADHD can look like autism, and why it is not. ADHD model validity open.

chapters.title: The virtual trial — who the model says responds, and who does not
chapters.one_liner: A synthetic population of 80 emerged cerebra (76 affected) with sampled fault mixes, run under stimulant, cap, and both. Responders are gain-dominated, non-responders wiring-dominated and partly cap-rescuable; an honest refutation shows the cap-unrescued residual is a dose-cap/stiffness limit, not a severe-wiring tail. Every fraction is an in-silico coupling state. efficacy=0.

chapters.title: Schizophrenia — the over-ignition mirror of autism
chapters.one_liner: Schizophrenia as the over-ignition mirror of autism-T on the same R19 ignitability axis: a disinhibitory bias lowers the fold so weak, irrelevant assemblies ignite (aberrant salience), where autism-T raises the fold and loses relevant ones. Its positive, negative and cognitive symptoms map onto the threshold, output and wiring axes, and a single gain-reducing antipsychotic operator reverses the positive domain only — a mechanistic account of why dopamine blockade relieves positive but not negative or cognitive symptoms. efficacy=0.

chapters.title: Epilepsy — the over-synchronisation pole
chapters.one_liner: Epilepsy as the over-synchronisation pole of the engine synchrony axis: an excitatory bias drives the global order parameter to the over-sync ceiling and the selective gate collapses, so every candidate assembly ignites — the ictal state (loss of gating). On one axis autism-T (under-ignited) < health (selective) < schizophrenia (aberrant) < epilepsy (all ignited); an inhibitory anticonvulsant-class push reverses it and raises the seizure threshold. The static susceptibility is characterised; the ictal time-course is owed to a state-switching layer (E2). efficacy=0.

chapters.title: The plasticity layer — consolidation and chronification
chapters.one_liner: The plasticity / consolidation layer the structural atlas never had: a slow phase-correlation Hebbian update of the ephaptic kernel (W_ij ← max(0, W_ij(1+η·C_ij)), C_ij = <cos(θ_j−θ_i)>; form forced, rate η open and signs swept). It makes consolidation and stimulation after-effects representable (E0.1), RESOLVES the open continuous-vs-periodic dosing question — spaced dosing leaves a larger retained structural trace than massed, so the cap repairs and pacing beats holding (E0.2) — and builds the reversible→chronified switch every temporal disorder needs: η=0 reverts, η>0 retains (E0.3). With η=0 it reproduces the frozen M9 anchor bit-for-bit (E0.4), a pure add-on. The layer, not a disorder; depression/bipolar/addiction import its substrate. efficacy=0.

chapters.title: Depression and treatment resistance — the chronification of a low-coordination operating point
chapters.one_liner: The first temporal disorder, built on the plasticity layer (it imports PlasticConnectome rather than re-deriving the rule). Major depression as the chronification of a low-coordination operating point: the engine's own HPA/stress axis (M18 cortisol + M17 valence) drives a sustained withdrawal bias that lowers coordination below health (acute, reversible), and with plasticity the excursion writes a retained structural trace that does not revert — the reversible→chronified switch. Antidepressant delayed onset is a consolidation timescale, treatment resistance is the depth of the trace; no new constant, η=0/stress=0 reproduces the frozen M9 anchor bit-for-bit. efficacy=0; not medical advice.

chapters.title: The state-switching layer — hysteresis, the fold, and the ictal time-course
chapters.one_liner: The fast counterpart to the plasticity layer: the R19 bistable cell ṡ = g·s − s³ + h read OVER TIME, with no new equation and no free constant (g=1.0 universal scale, fold = the engine's own spinodal(g), grids swept anti-tuning). Four results: hysteresis (loop width 2·spinodal≈0.77 — a state resists switching back); a transition latency that diverges at the fold (critical slowing) and falls with overshoot, CLOSING the §25 ictal time-course owed to E2; the barrier as switching threshold (shallow wells flip, deep wells hold); and const-drive integration reproducing the engine's settle bit-for-bit. The layer, not a disorder. efficacy=0.

chapters.title: Bipolar disorder — two poles on one axis, episodes as bistable switches
chapters.one_liner: The second temporal disorder and the first to use the state-switching layer: it IMPORTS both the plasticity layer (E0) and the switching layer (E2) and re-derives neither. Mania and depression are two operating poles on ONE valence axis (the M17 approach/M18 cortisol geometry); an episode is a bistable transition (E2 hysteresis+latency, persists past its trigger); kindling is the E0 trace accumulating across episodes (‖ΔW‖ 0.06→0.33, each switch easier); the mood-stabiliser sign is barrier-raising (flip threshold 0.38→0.64). η=0 reproduces the frozen M9 anchor bit-for-bit. Heterogeneity locked; addiction (T3a) owed. efficacy=0; not medical advice.

chapters.title: Bipolar threshold levers — the mood-stabiliser barrier-raise decomposed into three DNA-grounded levers
chapters.one_liner: Inherits the threshold-shift intervention logic from the analgesic reproducibility package (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.20733420) and uses it to DECOMPOSE §29's single abstract mood-stabiliser barrier-raise (B4) into a three-lever target map on the SAME R19 substrate, no new mechanism or tuned constant. L1 reduce inward excitatory current (CACNA1C/CACNA1D/CACNA1I/SCN2A/GRIN2A; CACNB2/ANK3 adjacent); L2 increase outward K+ current (KCNQ2/KCNQ3 M-current, KCNB1); L3 remove upstream circadian/HPA drive (ARNTL/CLOCK/PER2/NR3C1/CRHR1/GSK3B, all graded [O] cited biology). Each gene placed by its own promoter switch stiffness γ→|h_sp| (SantaLucia 1998, engine read-only). Fail-closed L3-honesty gate + forbidden-claim scanner + burden-weighted ranking of TARGETS (never drugs/doses), with γ carried as context but never folded into the score (firewall: promoter |h_sp| ≠ network barrier g ≠ voltage/potency/dose/clinical effect). Registered as 8th atlas citizen (BIP-T2b-L), reproduces bit-for-bit, engine byte-unchanged. efficacy=0; not medical advice.

chapters.title: Epilepsy threshold levers — the over-synchronisation threshold-raise decomposed into three DNA-grounded levers
chapters.one_liner: Applies the SAME threshold-shift intervention logic as §30 (inherited from the analgesic reproducibility package, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.20733420) to §25's over-synchronisation pole: §25 proved seizures are the network crossing an over-sync threshold on R and that the corrective sign is threshold-raising, but treated that push as ONE abstract operator. This chapter DECOMPOSES it into a three-lever target map on the SAME R19 substrate, no new mechanism or tuned constant. L1 reduce inward Na/Ca/NMDA current (SCN1A/SCN2A/SCN8A/CACNA1A/CACNA1H/GRIN2A); L2 (DOMINANT) increase outward K+ current (KCNQ2/KCNQ3 M-current = retigabine axis, KCNB1/KCNA1/KCNT1, GABA-A GABRG2/GABRA1 adjacent); L3 remove upstream mTOR drive (DEPDC5/TSC1/TSC2 = everolimus direction, all graded [O] cited biology). Five reads (KCNQ2/KCNQ3/KCNB1/SCN2A/GRIN2A) reuse the bipolar promoter cache verbatim (γ strand-symmetric). Two honest caveats recorded: KCNT1 sign-INVERTED, SCN1A Na-block CONTRAINDICATED in Dravet — hence γ is [V] for promoter STRUCTURE only, clinical direction [O]. Each gene placed by its own promoter switch stiffness γ→|h_sp| (SantaLucia 1998, engine read-only). Fail-closed L3-honesty gate + forbidden-claim scanner + burden-weighted ranking of TARGETS (never drugs/doses), γ carried as context but never folded into the score; decoupling witness: stiffest promoter CACNA1H ranks LOW, top-priority SCN1A reads near softest (firewall: promoter |h_sp| ≠ §25 network over-sync threshold on R ≠ voltage/potency/dose/clinical effect). Registered as 9th atlas citizen (EPI-T2a-L), reproduces bit-for-bit, engine byte-unchanged. efficacy=0; not medical advice.

chapters.title: Depression threshold levers — the low-coordination operating-point restoration decomposed into three DNA-grounded levers
chapters.one_liner: Applies the SAME threshold-shift intervention logic as §30/§31 (inherited from the analgesic reproducibility package, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.20733420) to §27's low-coordination pole, and is the FIRST L3-DOMINANT case: §27 proved major depression is the chronification of an operating point with R below health (a sustained HPA-driven withdrawal) and that the corrective sign is to RESTORE the deficient drive, but treated that push as ONE abstract operator. This chapter DECOMPOSES it into a three-lever target map on the SAME R19 substrate, no new mechanism or tuned constant. Of 18 genes, 12 sit on L3 — (a) HPA REMOVE: NR3C1 (restore glucocorticoid-receptor negative feedback), CRHR1, FKBP5; (b) monoamine RESTORE: SLC6A4 (SSRI site), SLC6A2 (SNRI site), MAOA (MAOI site), TPH2, HTR1A, HTR2A, COMT; (c) neurotrophic RESTORE: BDNF, NTRK2 (the convergence point of the rapid-acting and monoamine routes) — while only L1 (inward glutamatergic/Ca: GRIN2A/GRIN2B/CACNA1C) and L2 (outward K+/GABA-A: KCNQ2/KCNQ3/GABRA1) carry three genes each. The disorder-level SIGN is FLIPPED vs epilepsy/bipolar (restore deficient, not reduce excess), stated not hidden. Seven reads (NR3C1/CRHR1/GRIN2A/CACNA1C/KCNQ2/KCNQ3 from the bipolar cache, GABRA1 from the epilepsy cache) reuse the promoter caches verbatim (γ strand-symmetric). Two honest caveats: the L1 glutamatergic direction is an NMDA ANTAGONIST (the ketamine route) acting via DOWNSTREAM BDNF, not excitation reduction (sign-subtle); the HTR2A direction is NON-MONOTONE (agonist + antagonist routes both appear) — hence γ is [V] for promoter STRUCTURE only, clinical direction [O]. Each gene placed by its own promoter switch stiffness γ→|h_sp| (SantaLucia 1998, engine read-only). Fail-closed L3-honesty gate (asserts L3 dominant) + forbidden-claim scanner (incl. mood-lift/remission language) + burden-weighted ranking of TARGETS (BDNF tops the genetic and unmet-need tiers; unmet-need lifts upstream HPA/neurotrophic targets above well-served monoamine transporters; KCNQ2/KCNQ3/CACNA1C flagged not-actionable), γ carried as context but never folded into the score; decoupling witness: stiffest promoter KCNQ2 ranks LOW, top-priority BDNF reads mid-range (firewall: promoter |h_sp| ≠ §27 network operating-point on R ≠ receptor occupancy/monoamine level/potency/dose/clinical effect). Registered as 10th atlas citizen (DEP-T1b-L), reproduces bit-for-bit, engine byte-unchanged. efficacy=0; not medical advice.

chapters.title: Schizophrenia threshold levers — the over-ignition operating-point correction decomposed into DNA-grounded levers
chapters.one_liner: Applies the SAME threshold-shift intervention logic as §30/§31/§32 (inherited from the analgesic reproducibility package, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.20733420) to §24 over-ignition / aberrant-salience pole, and is the FIRST L1+L3 CO-DOMINANT case AND the FIRST domain-restricted case: §24 proved the positive symptoms are an over-ignition operating point (the ignition fold sits too low so weak assemblies ignite as hallucinations/delusions) and that the corrective sign is to REDUCE the excess drive (same direction as epilepsy/bipolar mania), and also that schizophrenia is NOT one axis but three distinct domains (positive/negative/cognitive). This chapter DECOMPOSES that single operator into a three-lever target map on the SAME R19 substrate, no new mechanism or tuned constant. Of 14 genes, 6 sit on L1 (the glutamate/NMDA inward axis: GRIN1, GRIN2A, GRIN2B, GRIA3, CACNA1C, CACNB2) and 6 on L3 (the dopamine up-stream axis in three sub-axes: receptors DRD2, DRD4; synthesis/transport TH, SLC6A3; serotonergic/catabolic HTR2A, COMT), while only L2 (GABA-A: GABRA1, GABRB3) is minor — the two leading pathophysiologies (glutamate hypofunction + dopamine) on the map at once. The NEW finding is the DOMAIN RESTRICTION: the gain-reducing scalar lever reverses the POSITIVE domain ONLY; the NEGATIVE (output/gain deficit) and COGNITIVE (long-range wiring/dysconnection) domains are NOT reached — a threshold shift cannot lift a deficit by lowering a fold nor re-route geometry (§19) — recorded in a domain-restriction witness. Seven reads (GRIN2A/CACNA1C/CACNB2 from the bipolar cache, GRIN2B/COMT/HTR2A/GABRA1 from the depression cache) reuse the promoter caches verbatim (γ strand-symmetric). Two honest caveats: the L1 NMDA-HYPOFUNCTION direction is sign-subtle (parvalbumin-interneuron NMDA hypofunction DISINHIBITS downstream circuits, so a glycine-site AGONIST direction appears alongside the naive reduce-excitation sign — the SZ analogue of depression ketamine caveat); the HTR2A direction is NON-MONOTONE — hence γ is [V] for promoter STRUCTURE only, clinical direction [O]. Each gene placed by its own promoter switch stiffness γ→|h_sp| (SantaLucia 1998, engine read-only). Fail-closed L3-honesty gate (asserts L1+L3 co-dominance AND positive-domain restriction) + forbidden-claim scanner (incl. treats-psychosis/remission/relapse-prevention language) + burden-weighted ranking of TARGETS (GRIN2A tops the genetic and unmet-need tiers; unmet-need lifts the glutamatergic L1 axis above the established D2 route; CACNA1C/CACNB2/DRD4/GABRB3/SLC6A3 flagged not-actionable — SLC6A3 because DAT blockade RAISES dopamine, the wrong direction), γ carried as context but never folded into the score; decoupling witness: stiffest promoter SLC6A3 ranks LOW and non-actionable, top-priority GRIN2A reads mid-range (firewall: promoter |h_sp| ≠ §24 network over-ignition threshold on R ≠ receptor occupancy/dopamine level/potency/dose/clinical effect). Registered as 11th atlas citizen (SZ-T1a-L), reproduces bit-for-bit, engine byte-unchanged. efficacy=0; not medical advice.

chapters.title: Autism threshold levers — the E/I over-excitation operating-point correction decomposed into DNA-grounded levers
chapters.one_liner: Applies the SAME threshold-shift intervention logic as §30/§31/§32/§33 (inherited from the analgesic reproducibility package, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.20733420) to the §18-19 autism E/I over-excitation pole, and is the UNIFICATION case: rather than introducing a new lever combination it re-expresses the pre-existing autism_multilever_threshold.py (which carried the idea under informal A1/A2/A3 levers) under the formal L1/L2/L3 frame. §18-19 proved autism is NOT one axis but three distinct fault axes — T (excitability / E-I threshold, an over-excitation operating point whose ignition fold sits too low), O (synaptic output / gain deficit), W (long-range wiring / connectivity) — that only the T axis is reachable by a scalar chemical lever (corrective sign: reduce the excess drive / restore inhibition, same direction as epilepsy / schizophrenia-positive), and (§19) that the W axis is PROVABLY unreachable (a threshold shift can only MASK a wiring fault by over-synchronisation — the seizure analogue, P5_threshold_lowering_is_mask_not_correction — never CORRECT it, P4_chemical_cannot_fix_W). This chapter DECOMPOSES the T-axis correction into a three-lever target map on the SAME R19 substrate, no new mechanism or tuned constant. Autism is the 5th distribution pattern across the series: L1-DOMINANT with a nearly-empty L3. Of 10 lever genes, 5 sit on L1 (the excitatory-reduce axis: GRIN2A, GRIN2B, GRIA1, SCN2A, CACNA1C), 4 on L2 (the inhibitory-restore axis: KCNQ3 M-current K+, GABRB3, GABRA5, GABRA2), and just 1 on L3 (SLC6A4, a cautious non-monotone serotonergic node graded [O]) — the L3-sparsity is itself the finding, that autism's actionable biology sits locally on the E/I set with no clean up-stream drug drive (the mirror of depression's L3-dominance). TWO structural strengthenings beyond the schizophrenia domain-restriction template: (1) the OUT-OF-REACH axes are NAMED with six real genes — O (output deficit) = SHANK3, SYNGAP1, NRXN1; W (long-range wiring) = CNTNAP2, RELN; plus the syndromic master MECP2 — carried on the map but explicitly NOT levers; (2) the W-axis unreachability is PROVEN, not asserted (§19). Seven reads (GRIN2A/GRIN2B/CACNA1C/GABRB3 from the schizophrenia cache, SCN2A/KCNQ3 from the bipolar cache, SLC6A4 from the depression cache) reuse the promoter caches verbatim (γ strand-symmetric). Two honest caveats: SCN2A and GRIN2B are GoF/LoF SIGN-SUBTLE (gain-of-function → early DEE/seizure pole; loss-of-function → milder ASD/ID pole — opposite directions), and the T lever pushed TOO HARD is itself the seizure edge (the real ASD+epilepsy comorbidity) — hence γ is [V] for promoter STRUCTURE only, clinical direction [O]. Each gene placed by its own promoter switch stiffness γ→|h_sp| (SantaLucia 1998, engine read-only); across all 16 genes the decoupling names itself — the stiffest reads are the out-of-reach SHANK3/RELN and the sparse L3 SLC6A4, the softest are the actionable E/I levers SCN2A/CACNA1C (stiffness runs OPPOSITE to reachability). Fail-closed L3-honesty gate (asserts L1 UNIQUE dominance, L3 SPARSITY, the T-axis restriction, and the NAMED + §19-proven O/W out-of-reach axes) + forbidden-claim scanner — the strictest in the series, adding an autism QUACKERY class (chelation / MMS / bleach protocols) and a NORMALISE-framing class protecting neurodiversity respect (autism is a DIFFERENCE, not only a deficit) — + burden-weighted ranking of the 10 LEVER genes only (the AUTISM unmet-need signature: no approved core-feature pharmacology → U uniformly high, no DRD2-analogue lowering it; the L2 inhibitory-restore route GABRB3/GABRA5/KCNQ3/GABRA2 surfaces as the cleanest ACTIONABLE direction because the high-scoring L1 excitatory genes are GoF/LoF sign-subtle — restoring inhibition raises the fold regardless of variant direction), γ carried as context but never folded into the score; decoupling witness: stiffest lever read SLC6A4 ranks LAST and non-actionable, top-priority GABRB3 reads mid-range (firewall: promoter |h_sp| ≠ §18 network over-excitation threshold on R ≠ receptor occupancy / synaptic level / potency / dose / clinical effect). Registered as 12th atlas citizen (ASD-T-L), reproduces bit-for-bit, engine byte-unchanged. efficacy=0; targets ranked, never drugs; autism is a difference, not only a deficit; not medical advice.

chapters.title: ADHD threshold levers — the drive-tone / arousal operating-point correction decomposed into DNA-grounded levers (L3-only; first partial fit)
chapters.one_liner: Applies the SAME threshold-shift intervention logic as §30/§31/§32/§33/§34 (inherited from the analgesic reproducibility package, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.20733420) to the §22 adhd_axis_specific substrate (ADHD = gain/arousal with INTACT WIRING: six output/gain genes, two arousal/threshold genes, ZERO wiring genes; FOXP2/ADGRL3 pre-registered out), and is the FIRST PARTIAL [L] fit in the series. Mapped by REACHABILITY, ADHD is L3-ONLY: of 5 lever genes ALL 5 sit on L3 (the up-stream catecholamine/monoaminergic drive — SLC6A3/DAT and DRD4/D4, §22-O gain genes reachable here as drive-TONE; SLC6A4/SERT and ADRA2A/α2A, §22-T arousal tone; SLC6A2/NET, the atomoxetine arm), and L1 and L2 are BOTH EMPTY — the 6th distribution pattern and the PUREST L3 case (the L1/L2 emptiness is itself the finding: ADHD is NOT a channelopathy, it has no ionic fold lever, only the [O] cited-biology drive surface). The fit is PARTIAL [L] for a two-sided reason: (1) the DOMINANT axis is OUT OF REACH — ADHD is a gain/arousal disorder not a firing-FOLD disorder, so the drive-tone lever reaches only the SECONDARY drive-tone surface and NOT the GA gain-amplitude machinery (synthesis/release), which is the dominant fault, NAMED with four real genes (TH/DBH synthesis, SNAP25 release, COMT catabolic clearance boundary) carried with γ alongside but graded [F] NOT REACHED; (2) the frame has NO structural [F] grounding (L1/L2 empty, only the [O] drive surface). And W is ABSENT (intact wiring, zero genes) — the discriminant from autism, which carried a W axis §19-proven unreachable. This is the precise INVERSE of autism: autism reached its DOMINANT axis and missed O+W; ADHD reaches only the SECONDARY axis and misses the DOMINANT axis, with no W. Six reads (SLC6A3/DRD4/SLC6A4/TH/COMT from the depression/schizophrenia caches) reuse the caches verbatim (γ strand-symmetric); ADRA2A/DBH/SNAP25 are live GRCh38 strand-aware reads. The DNA reads carry an INVERSION that names itself: the stiffest promoter (SLC6A3, γ≈1.598) is a REACHABLE lever while the softest (SNAP25, γ≈1.438) is an OUT-OF-REACH gain gene — the exact opposite of autism. Fail-closed L3-honesty gate (asserts L3 UNIQUE dominance, L1==L2==0 emptiness, the GA-axis named-out-of-reach, the W-axis ABSENCE, and the PARTIAL [L] grade) + forbidden-claim scanner — the strictest in the series, adding a STIMULANT-MISUSE class (get-high/snort/euphoria/recreational/party-drug) and a COGNITIVE-ENHANCEMENT class (smart-drug/study-drug/nootropic/limitless), both negation-guarded with planted self-tests — + burden-weighted ranking of all 9 targets, γ carried as context but never folded into the score. The ADHD unmet-need signature is the INVERSE of autism's: ADHD HAS established core routes (DAT/stimulant, NET/atomoxetine, α2A/guanfacine) → reachable transporters carry LOW unmet need (lowest floor in the series), out-of-reach gain genes carry the ceiling but are non-actionable, so the highest-burden targets (TH #1, DRD4 #2, DBH #3, SNAP25 #4) are all NON-actionable and the leading ACTIONABLE target SLC6A3/DAT sits only #5; decoupling witness (inverse of autism's): the stiffest promoter SLC6A3 ranks #5 not the top, top-priority TH reads third-stiffest (firewall: promoter |h_sp| ≠ transporter occupancy / synaptic catecholamine level / stimulant potency / dose / clinical effect). Registered as 13th atlas citizen (ADHD-T-L), reproduces bit-for-bit, engine byte-unchanged. efficacy=0; targets ranked, never drugs; no stimulant-misuse or cognitive-enhancement licence; ADHD is a difference in regulation, not a deficit of worth; not medical advice.

chapters.title: Addiction threshold levers — the incentive-sensitisation / reward-drive operating-point correction decomposed into DNA-grounded levers (L3-dominant with L1+L2 engaged; the second partial fit)
chapters.one_liner: Applies the SAME threshold-shift intervention logic as §30/§31/§32/§33/§34/§35 (inherited from the analgesic reproducibility package, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.20733420) to the §26/§28 incentive-sensitisation substrate (addiction = a sensitised reward GAIN CONSOLIDATED by plasticity that persists after withdrawal, driving relapse and cue-reactivity), and is the SECOND PARTIAL [L] fit in the series. Mapped by REACHABILITY, addiction is L3-DOMINANT WITH L1 AND L2 BOTH ENGAGED: of 9 lever genes 5 sit on L3 (the up-stream reward drive — SLC6A3/DAT-bupropion, DRD2/D2-Taq1A, OPRM1/μ-naltrexone, OPRK1/κ, CHRNA5/α5-varenicline), 2 on L1 (glutamate-plasticity GRIN2A/GRIN2B, the acamprosate/NAC direction), and 2 on L2 (inhibitory-restore GABRG3/GABRA2, the topiramate direction; GABRA2 the alcohol-GWAS locus) — the 7th distribution pattern and the TEXTURAL INVERSE of ADHD's L3-only emptiness (ADHD was 'not a channelopathy'; addiction ENGAGES the ionic levers, a richer reachable surface). Yet the fit is STILL PARTIAL [L], and for a DEEPER reason than ADHD's: the reachable surface is the INSTANTANEOUS drive/excitability axis (reached across L1/L2/L3), but the DOMINANT addiction fault — the SG consolidated-sensitisation-gain axis, the learned reward amplitude that drives chronicity — is DOUBLY OUT OF REACH: it is a GAIN not a fold (the ADHD lesson) AND it is CONSOLIDATED/LEARNED, a plasticity (E0-layer) variable, not an instantaneous operating point any lever can move. The SG axis is NAMED with four real genes (FOSB/ΔFosB master switch, BDNF neurotrophin, CREB1, ARC immediate-early) carried with γ alongside but graded [F] NOT REACHED. THE CONVERGENCE: addiction's out-of-reach SG axis IS precisely the §26 E0 plasticity layer — the point where threshold-leverisation (B-i) meets the plasticity-dynamics route (B-ii), and B-i names the learned trace out-of-reach honestly. Six reads (SLC6A3/DRD2/GRIN2A/GRIN2B/GABRA2/BDNF from the depression/schizophrenia/autism caches) reuse the caches verbatim (γ strand-symmetric); the seven opioid/nicotinic/plasticity genes (OPRM1/OPRK1/CHRNA5/GABRG3/FOSB/CREB1/ARC) are live GRCh38 strand-aware reads. The DNA reads carry an inversion ORTHOGONAL to reach (unlike ADHD's aligned inversion): the stiffest promoter (SLC6A3, γ≈1.598, |h_sp|≈0.778) is a REACHABLE lever, the SOFTEST (OPRM1, γ≈1.255, |h_sp|≈0.541) is ALSO a reachable lever, and the out-of-reach ARC (γ≈1.580) is the SECOND-stiffest — so stiffness predicts neither reach nor priority. Fail-closed L3-honesty gate (asserts L3 dominance, L1>0 AND L2>0, the SG-axis named-out-of-reach, the INSTANT/SG domain restriction, and the PARTIAL [L] grade) + forbidden-claim scanner adding THREE substance-topic classes — DRUG-SEEKING (where-to-buy/how-to-obtain/inject/snort/get-high/euphoria/dealer), CURE-MIRACLE (miracle-cure/guaranteed-sober/detox-miracle/addiction-gone), MORAL-FRAMING (moral-failing/just-stop), all negation-guarded with planted self-tests — + burden-weighted ranking of all 13 targets, γ carried as context but never folded into the score. The ADDICTION unmet-need signature: the TOP of the ranking is NON-actionable — FOSB #1 (out-of-reach SG), the SG genes cluster top (FOSB #1, ARC #3, BDNF #4, CREB1 #5), the leading ACTIONABLE target OPRM1/μ sits #2, and the unmet-need FLOOR is 3 (above ADHD's 2, because even reachable routes are only PARTIALLY effective and relapse is high). Decoupling witness (starker than ADHD's, stiffness orthogonal to all): the stiffest promoter SLC6A3 ranks #9 near the BOTTOM, top-priority FOSB reads seventh-stiffest (firewall: promoter |h_sp| ≠ receptor occupancy / synaptic dopamine-opioid level / potency / dose / clinical effect, AND ≠ the consolidated sensitisation gain itself / the ΔFosB trace). Registered as 14th atlas citizen (ADD-T-L), reproduces bit-for-bit, engine byte-unchanged. efficacy=0; targets ranked, never drugs; no drug-seeking/miracle-cure/moral-failing licence; addiction is a treatable medical condition, not a moral failing; hard problem OPEN; not medical advice.

chapters.title: Addiction sensitisation dynamics — the consolidated sensitisation gain §36 named out of reach, modelled directly on the E0 plasticity layer (the B-ii half of the convergence, closed)
chapters.one_liner: The B-ii half of the §36 convergence, closed. §36 (ADD-T-L) applied the inherited threshold-lever frame and named addiction's DOMINANT fault — the consolidated sensitisation gain (the ΔFosB/BDNF/CREB1/ARC plasticity trace that makes addiction chronic and relapsing) — DOUBLY OUT OF REACH of any instant L1/L2/L3 lever (a GAIN not a fold, the ADHD lesson, AND a LEARNED/CONSOLIDATED plasticity variable), grading it [F] NOT REACHED. This module MODELS that SG axis directly: it IMPORTS the §26 E0 PlasticConnectome (reused, not re-derived) and drives it with a REWARD bias whose SIGN is grounded READ-ONLY in the engine — M5 dopamine reward-prediction error potentiates the rewarded eddy (p≈0.8985 vs control 0.20), M4 commits a winner — so a reward-exposure epoch maps to a positive reward-drive bias and the E0 Hebbian update accumulates it into a retained ‖W−W₀‖ trace (the integrated sensitisation gain as a STRUCTURAL quantity). Five pre-registered SIGN-only predictions all CONFIRMED and all surviving an η sweep (anti-tuning): A1 INCENTIVE SENSITISATION (the trace builds monotonically with exposure, 0→0.077→0.153→0.227→0.333→0.429), A2 CUE-REACTIVITY (the sensitised connectome responds MORE to the same reward cue than a naive one, resting R already ≥ the M9 anchor — the relapse substrate; only the response-exceeds-naive SIGN asserted, the marginal cue gain NOT claimed monotone), A3 EXTINCTION-PERSISTENCE (removing the reward leaves the trace ABOVE zero under plasticity, ≈0.428 and still consolidating, while η=0 leaves it EXACTLY zero — extinction removes the reachable DRIVE but not the out-of-reach LEARNED trace: the convergence seam, dynamically), A4 the PLASTICITY-VARIABLE GUARD (η=0 reverts the reward excursion EXACTLY, W identical to the kernel, R back to the frozen M9 anchor ≈0.38961 bit-for-bit — the gain vanishes without plasticity, proving it a LEARNED variable, which is precisely WHY §36's instant levers cannot reach it; pure add-on), and A5 the DYNAMICS HANDLE (SPACED/intermittent exposure consolidates a LARGER trace than MASSED/continuous at equal exposure, ≈0.225 vs 0.115 — intermittent reinforcement sensitises more, the structural HANDLE on the trace the instant frame could not reach). The two halves of the convergence MEET in one disorder: the threshold frame (B-i) names the gain unreachable for instant levers, the plasticity-dynamics frame (B-ii) both EXHIBITS the gain (A1–A3) and gives a HANDLE on it (A5). No new mechanism, no new tuned constant; the E0 layer is IMPORTED not re-derived; the engine is READ-ONLY and byte-unchanged. FIREWALL: the retained ‖W−W₀‖ is the integrated sensitisation gain as a STRUCTURAL quantity, NEVER the FELT quality of craving/reward/relapse (Axis-A; consciousness_claim=0; hard problem OPEN); real addiction plasticity is HETEROGENEOUS and only the SIGN of a phase-correlation Hebbian trace is asserted; the reward SIGN is grounded in M5 RPE and every MAGNITUDE (η, the real plasticity-rule identity) is [O]. Registered as the 15th atlas citizen (ADD-T3a), reproducing bit-for-bit. efficacy=0; not medical advice; no cure; no licence to acquire or use any substance; addiction is a chronic, relapsing MEDICAL condition, not a moral failing; hard problem OPEN.

chapters.title: Alzheimer's threshold levers — the cholinergic / glutamatergic / network symptomatic operating-point correction decomposed into DNA-grounded levers (third & deepest partial fit)
chapters.one_liner: Applies the SAME threshold-shift intervention logic as §30–§36 (inherited from the analgesic reproducibility package, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.20733420) to the cholinergic-deficit / glutamatergic-excitotoxicity / network-hyperexcitability substrate of Alzheimer's, and is the THIRD and DEEPEST PARTIAL [L] fit in the series. Mapped by REACHABILITY, Alzheimer's is L3-DOMINANT WITH L1 AND L2 BOTH ENGAGED and carries a SPLIT corrective sign: of 9 lever genes 4 sit on L3 (the up-stream cholinergic drive, RESTORED — ACHE/BCHE cholinesterases the donepezil/rivastigmine/galantamine direction, CHRNA7 α7-nicotinic, CHRM1 M1-muscarinic), 2 on L1 (glutamatergic excitotoxicity, REDUCED — GRIN2B/GRIN2A, the memantine direction), and 3 on L2 (inhibitory restore, RESTORED against AD network hyperexcitability — GABRA1/GABRA5/GABRB3) — the 8th distribution pattern and the FIRST reachable surface that is BOTH purely SYMPTOMATIC and SPLIT-SIGN (drive up, excitotoxicity down, inhibition up). The fit is PARTIAL [L] for the DEEPEST reason in the series: the DOMINANT fault — the PROG neurodegenerative-progression axis (APP amyloid source, PSEN1/PSEN2 γ-secretase, MAPT tau, APOE the strongest common risk allele, TREM2 microglial) — is OUT OF REACH because it is a gain/loss not a fold (the ADHD lesson) AND a progression over time, a plasticity-layer variable (the addiction lesson), AND moreover a DEGENERATION — a cumulative, irreversible LOSS, an E0 DECAY that is the structural INVERSE of addiction's E0 GAIN (addiction consolidates a trace the levers cannot erase; Alzheimer's loses a substrate the levers cannot rebuild), so even a drive lever that restores instantaneous cholinergic tone cannot HALT the cumulative loss. The PROG axis is NAMED with six real genes carried with γ alongside but graded [F] NOT REACHED. Five reads (GRIN2A/GRIN2B/GABRA5/GABRB3 from the autism cache, GABRA1 from the epilepsy cache) reuse the caches verbatim (γ strand-symmetric); the ten cholinergic/progression genes (ACHE/BCHE/CHRNA7/CHRM1/APP/PSEN1/PSEN2/MAPT/APOE/TREM2) are live GRCh38 strand-aware reads. The DNA reads carry a decoupling ORTHOGONAL to reach (like addiction): the three STIFFEST promoters (CHRM1/ACHE/CHRNA7) are all reachable cholinergic levers, the two SOFTEST (BCHE/GABRA1) are ALSO reachable, and the six out-of-reach PROG genes cluster in the MIDDLE — so stiffness predicts neither axis nor reach. Fail-closed L3-honesty gate (asserts L3 dominance, L1>0 AND L2>0, the SPLIT symptomatic sign, the PROG-axis named-out-of-reach, and the PARTIAL [L] grade) + forbidden-claim scanner adding TWO dementia-topic classes — CURE_REVERSAL (reverse/cure/prevent/halt-progression/restore-lost-memory/regrow-neurons/miracle-cure) and DIGNITY (empty-shell/no-longer-a-person/vegetable/already-gone/not-worth-treating), both negation-guarded with planted self-tests — + burden-weighted ranking of all 15 targets, γ carried as context but never folded into the score. The ALZHEIMER'S unmet-need signature is the deepest-partial of all: the TOP of the ranking is NON-actionable — APP #1 and APOE #2 (out-of-reach PROG, disease-modification the greatest unmet need), the leading ACTIONABLE target ACHE sits #3, and the unmet-need FLOOR is 3 (above ADHD's 2, because the reachable routes are symptomatic only and do not slow the disease). Decoupling witness: the stiffest promoter CHRM1 ranks #6 not the top, top-priority APP reads seventh-stiffest (firewall: promoter |h_sp| ≠ neurodegeneration rate / amyloid burden / tau load / receptor occupancy / potency / dose / clinical effect). Registered as 16th atlas citizen (AD-T3b-L), reproduces bit-for-bit, engine byte-unchanged. efficacy=0; targets ranked, never drugs; cholinesterase inhibitors and memantine are symptomatic only and do not slow progression; the anti-amyloid antibodies target the out-of-reach progression axis; a person living with dementia remains a person; hard problem OPEN; not medical advice.

chapters.title: Alzheimer's progression dynamics — the neurodegenerative decay §38 named out of reach, modelled directly on the E0 plasticity layer as the structural inverse of addiction's gain (the B-ii half of the convergence, closed)
chapters.one_liner: Models the dominant Alzheimer's fault §38 (AD-T3b-L, B-i) named OUT OF REACH for the instant symptomatic levers — the PROG neurodegenerative-progression axis (the cumulative, irreversible loss of synapses and neurons) — DIRECTLY, by REUSING the §26 E0 PlasticConnectome (the kernel, coupling map and order-parameter machinery, imported not re-derived) and applying to that frozen kernel the structural INVERSE of E0's Hebbian consolidation: a slow progressive CONNECTIVITY ATTRITION (synapse/neuron loss, mass DOWN where §37 drove mass UP). Unlike §37 (whose reward SIGN came from the engine's M5 RPE), the engine has NO degeneration signal, so the loss DIRECTION is grounded as the structural inverse of E0 GAIN (definitional loss); the BASELINE being lost (the frozen M9 anchor) and the GUARD are grounded read-only. Five pre-registered SIGN-only results, all CONFIRMED over a decay-rate sweep, each the inverse of a §37 result: D1 progressive degeneration (connectivity loss accumulates monotonically, deeper -> less surviving mass and lower coordination R), D2 loss of responsiveness (a degenerated connectome responds LESS to the same cue than a healthy one — progressive functional decline, the inverse of cue-reactivity), D3 levers-do-not-rebuild (the symptomatic cue leaves the cumulative loss EXACTLY unchanged, and at deep loss even the maximum cue cannot reach the healthy anchor — relief WITHOUT disease modification, the convergence seam, the inverse of extinction-persistence; exactly why cholinesterase inhibitors and memantine are symptomatic only), D4 the structural-variable guard (decay=0 reverts to the frozen M9 anchor bit-for-bit — degeneration is a structural-loss variable the instant levers cannot reach, pure add-on), and D5 the dynamics handle (a lower decay rate preserves strictly more structure while the symptomatic cue has NO structural handle — the handle lives ONLY on the progression axis, the disease-modification direction where the anti-amyloid antibodies act; the inverse of the spacing handle). The two halves of the AD convergence meet in one disorder, the exact INVERSE of the addiction convergence: addiction CONSOLIDATES a trace the levers cannot erase (E0 GAIN), Alzheimer's LOSES a substrate the levers cannot rebuild (E0 DECAY). Registered as the 17th atlas citizen (AD-T3b-D), reproduces bit-for-bit, engine byte-unchanged. efficacy=0; the connectivity loss is a STRUCTURAL quantity, never the felt quality of memory/loss/selfhood; a person living with dementia REMAINS a person; hard problem OPEN; not medical advice; no cure, reversal, prevention or halt of progression.

chapters.title: OCD threshold levers — the serotonergic / glutamatergic / circuit instantaneous operating-point correction decomposed into DNA-grounded levers (L3-dominant with L1 strong and L2 sparse and a mixed sign; the pathological loop-lock out of reach — the fourth partial fit and a new E0 mode)
chapters.one_liner: Applies the SAME threshold-shift intervention logic (inherited from the analgesic reproducibility package, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.20733420) to the cortico-striato-thalamo-cortical (CSTC) loop substrate of OCD — the worry-compulsion loop that settles into a self-sustaining, over-consolidated, pathologically STABILISED attractor — and produces the FOURTH PARTIAL [L] fit and a NEW MODE. Mapped by REACHABILITY, OCD is L3-DOMINANT with L1 STRONG and L2 SPARSE and carries a MIXED corrective sign: of 8 lever genes, 4 sit on L3 (SLC6A4/HTR2A/HTR1B RESTORE the serotonergic tone — the SSRI/clomipramine first-line; DRD2 REDUCES the dopaminergic drive — antipsychotic augmentation), 3 on L1 (SLC1A1/EAAT3 the most replicated OCD gene, GRIN2B, GRIK2 — the glutamate-modulator direction, REDUCED), 1 on L2 (GABRA1, a single SPARSE inhibitory node — OCD's GABAergic arm is thin, itself a finding). Unlike Alzheimer's purely-symptomatic surface, the OCD levers are the actual mainstay/investigational routes and genuinely (PARTIALLY) help. The fit is PARTIAL [L] because the DOMINANT fault — the LOCK pathological-stabilisation axis (the corticostriatal circuit-fixation machinery DLGAP3/SAPAP3 the canonical OCD-model scaffold, SLITRK5, PTPRD, BTBD3) — is NAMED with 4 real genes but graded [F] NOT REACHED, because LOCK is a gain/loss not a fold (the ADHD lesson) AND a consolidated/learned plasticity E0-layer variable (the addiction lesson) AND moreover a pathological STABILISATION — an over-deep basin / hysteresis (an E2 phenomenon), an E0 STABILISATION that is the THIRD distinct E0 mode, completing the trio addiction GAIN → Alzheimer's DECAY → OCD STABILISATION. So the levers nudge the operating point but do not unstick the loop; deep-brain stimulation of the CSTC loop and exposure-response-prevention are the dynamics handles the levers are not. Five of twelve reads are carried VERBATIM from the depression/addiction/autism/epilepsy caches (gamma is strand-symmetric); the seven new genes are live GRCh38 strand-aware reads. Registered as the 18th atlas citizen (OCD-T3c-L), reproduces bit-for-bit, engine byte-unchanged. efficacy=0; targets ranked, never drugs or doses; not medical advice; the reachable levers genuinely but partially help and do not unstick the loop; OCD is a treatable medical condition and intrusive thoughts are a symptom, not a moral failing; consciousness_claim=0; hard problem OPEN.

chapters.title: OCD stabilisation dynamics — the self-sustaining stuck loop §40 named out of reach, modelled directly on the E0 plasticity layer as the third E0 mode (the B-ii half of the convergence, closed)
chapters.one_liner: Models the dominant compulsion-maintaining axis of OCD — the self-sustaining STUCK LOOP §40 (OCD-T3c-L, B-i) named OUT OF REACH for the instant symptomatic levers — DIRECTLY on the E0 plasticity layer as the THIRD E0 MODE (after addiction GAIN and Alzheimer's DECAY, completing the trio). REUSES the §26 PlasticConnectome (imported, not re-derived) and drives the frozen kernel through E0's potentiating Hebbian update, at a negatively-reinforced coordinated point, into a self-sustaining locked loop. STABILISATION shares the addiction GAIN's consolidation family (the same update writes a trace, mass UP) and is DISTINGUISHED by its READOUT — the locked loop holds its own coordination above the M9 anchor AT REST with NO external cue. Five sign-only results, all CONFIRMED over eta and bias sweeps: S1 progressive stabilisation (trace 0→0.18→0.35→0.50 over 0-18 epochs, the locked state deepening, Rlock deeper>=shallower), S2 the self-sustaining loop (Rlock>=anchor and >=cold-start branch with no cue, Rlock~0.405 vs Rfresh~0.396 at 18 epochs, the excess growing — the defining readout distinguishing it from GAIN's cue-reactivity and DECAY's decline), S3 levers-do-not-unstick (the symptomatic lever leaves the trace EXACTLY unchanged and even the maximum lever cannot reduce it — relief without re-writing the loop, the seam), S4 the structural-variable guard (consolidation=0 reverts to the frozen M9 anchor bit-for-bit via the faithful integrator from the engine's own fixed IC), S5 the dynamics handle (a lower consolidation rate writes strictly less structure while the lever has no structural handle — the handle lives only on the consolidation/learning axis where ERP re-writing acts). HONEST DISANALOGY with §37: the engine has NO stuck-loop signal, so the stabilisation sign is grounded as the same E0 consolidation family as the GAIN (not an engine pathology signal — the addiction sign came from M5 RPE); the basin-depth concept is grounded in the READ-ONLY R19 barrier B(g)=g²/4=0.25, and NO network-hysteresis is claimed (the network has no clean bistability under these couplings). Registered as the 19th atlas citizen (OCD-T3c-D), reproduces bit-for-bit, engine byte-unchanged. efficacy=0; not medical advice; OCD is a treatable condition and an intrusive thought is a symptom, not a moral failing; consciousness_claim=0; hard problem OPEN.

chapters.title: The E0 triad synthesis — addiction's gain, Alzheimer's decay and OCD's stabilisation, certified as three readouts of one plasticity layer (the capstone, zero new measurement)
chapters.one_liner: The capstone of the three-mode E0-dynamics arc. The addiction (§37), Alzheimer's (§39) and OCD (§41) chapters each modelled one named disorder DIRECTLY on the SAME §26 E0 plasticity layer — addiction as GAIN (a sensitised reward trace that responds MORE to a cue), Alzheimer's as DECAY (the structural inverse, a substrate LOST), OCD as STABILISATION (a self-sustaining trace that holds its own coordination AT REST with no cue). With the third face frozen the arc CLOSES, and this chapter is a META-SYNTHESIS — NOT a new model — that steps back to certify the single structural statement they jointly make: ONE plasticity layer, read THREE ways. Zero new measurement, zero new machinery, zero new tuned constant. Discipline of a synthesis: the three source results JSONs are the SSOT, and BEFORE reading a single number it re-computes each one's SHA-256 and checks it BIT-FOR-BIT against the frozen value (GAIN 20dfb3e9…, DECAY 7a8e8513…, STABILISATION ef37d619…); only then are they read, and the engine is emerged READ-ONLY and confirmed byte-unchanged (0fbf4988…). Five certifications, all CONFIRMED: T1 ONE SHARED LAYER (all three import the same PlasticConnectome, and with the plasticity process off all three revert to the same frozen M9 anchor R~0.38961 BIT-FOR-BIT — one layer, one off-state: the structure the gain consolidates onto, the substrate the decay strips, the baseline the loop locks around); T2 THREE DIRECTIONS OF MASS (gain writes a trace mass-up 0.227, decay deletes a substrate mass-down 5.52 the inverse, stabilisation writes a trace mass-up 0.498 gain's direction — distinct, the mass cut sorting gain+stabilisation together vs decay); T3 THREE READOUTS (cue-reactivity / loss-of-responsiveness / self-sustenance at rest, stabilisation Rlock~0.405 above the anchor with no cue over Rfresh~0.396); T4 SAME FAMILY, DIFFERENT READOUT (driven to the same operating point the gain and stabilisation traces are LITERALLY IDENTICAL 0.35285==0.35285, and OCD is distinguished only by the self-sustaining readout — exactly the honest disanalogy §41 declared, here shown to be the literal truth); T5 ONE SEAM, ONE HANDLE (in all three the instant symptomatic lever leaves the structural quantity EXACTLY unchanged — relief without re-writing — and the only handle lives on the plasticity axis: spacing / progression rate / consolidation rate where ERP acts). Registered as the 20th and FINAL atlas citizen (E0-SYNTH), placed LAST so the three source JSONs are freshly regenerated before their hashes are re-verified; reproduces bit-for-bit, engine byte-unchanged. FIREWALL inherited THREEFOLD: every trace, loss and locked coordination is a STRUCTURAL quantity, NEVER the felt quality of a craving, of memory or selfhood, or of an intrusive thought or compulsion (Axis-A; consciousness_claim=0; hard problem OPEN); addiction is a chronic relapsing medical condition, a person with dementia remains a person, OCD is treatable and an intrusive thought is a symptom, not a moral failing; only structural signs and relations are asserted, every magnitude is [O]; nothing is a cure, reversal or prevention; efficacy=0; not medical advice.

chapters.title: Spatial localisation — the global scalar drive generalised to a per-node spatial profile (the field-shaping layer E1): a fixed-structure field, heterogeneous reach with a drive-stable hub, a drive-invariant self/relay class, and no universal focal-versus-diffuse law
chapters.one_liner: The spatial sibling of the §26 plasticity layer. Every disorder module to date drove the brain GLOBALLY — one scalar coupling Kglob raised or lowered for the whole network at once (schizophrenia, epilepsy, the θ-cap) — so focal-versus-diffuse stimulation, off-target spillover and region-specific disease could not even be posed. This layer generalises the scalar to a per-node coupling vector Kvec_i = k(b_i)·OMEGA0 (a spatial drive PROFILE) set through the SAME k=κ/(1−|b|) map as the SZ/epilepsy/E0 modules (no new constant), and reads a per-node local-coherence field c_i = <Σ_j W0_ij cos(θ_j−θ_i)> as a READ-ONLY side computation. The FORM is forced [F] (the frozen ~1/r³ row-stochastic kernel plus the existing map); the PROFILE (driven node, depth b0) is [O] swept and every sign/structure holds across a depth sweep b0∈{0.3,0.5,0.7,0.9} (anti-tuning). Four results, all CONFIRMED: E1.1 THE FIELD HAS A FIXED SPATIAL STRUCTURE — the kernel is LOCAL (every row's weight monotone-decreases with anatomical distance, all 12 rows) and NORMALISED (every row sums to 1, deviation 2e-16), exact geometry; E1.2 PERTURBATION REACH IS HETEROGENEOUS WITH A DRIVE-STABLE HUB — reach(i)=|R−R0| varies >100× and the cerebellum is the rank-1 reach hub at EVERY swept depth, the full ranking invariant for moderate-to-high drive (Spearman=1.0 among b0≥0.5), a connectome invariant; E1.3 (the headline) THE SELF-LOCALISING vs RELAY CLASSIFICATION IS DRIVE-INVARIANT — each node's focal footprint either self-localises (own |Δc|>mean off-target) or relays (lands harder off-target), and this binary class is IDENTICAL across the entire depth sweep, the relay set {hippocampus, midbrain} fixed at every amplitude: whether a site contains or relays its drive is a fixed property of position; E1.4 (the honest no-tuning result) THERE IS NO UNIVERSAL FOCAL>DIFFUSE LAW — delivering equal total dose focally vs diffusely the sign of (focal−diffuse) target-gain VARIES across sites (9/12 concentrate), so spatial outcome is site-determined and disease built on this layer must be REGION-SPECIFIC, never global; the refuted clean hypothesis is reported honestly. A uniform drive reproduces the frozen M9 anchor R=0.38961455156 BIT-FOR-BIT and the off-state field equals baseline exactly (S4); engine imported READ-ONLY and byte-unchanged (0fbf4988…). The SpatialField class is the reusable layer the later region-specific modules (focal foci, lesion fields, off-target neuromodulation) import; those are owed. FIREWALL absolute: a local-coherence field, a reach map and a self/relay class are STRUCTURAL spatial quantities of the coupling model, NEVER the felt locus of an experience and NOT a real electrode, current density or dose (Axis-A; consciousness_claim=0; hard problem OPEN); only structural signs and relations are asserted, every magnitude is [O]; nothing is a cure, reversal or prevention; efficacy=0; not medical advice.

chapters.title: Focal epilepsy — containment vs secondary generalisation: the first region-specific application of the spatial-localisation layer (E1-FOC), and the honest finding that off-target spread is not global hypersynchrony (two decoupled axes; the spatial refinement of §25 over-sync epilepsy)
chapters.one_liner: The FIRST region-specific application of the §43 spatial-localisation layer (E1) and the spatial refinement of the §25 (T2a) over-synchronisation epilepsy module. §25 certified the seizure as the network crossing the over-sync threshold on the GLOBAL order R, but it drove the brain GLOBALLY (one scalar Kglob), so it could not ask the central clinical question about a FOCAL epilepsy: does a seizure that BEGINS at one focus STAY focal or SECONDARILY GENERALISE? That is intrinsically SPATIAL, and §43 is the layer that makes ‘where’ representable. This module IMPORTS the SpatialField (it does NOT re-derive the ephaptic kernel or the k(b) map) and reads a focal seizure focus as a strong focal EXCITATORY ictal drive at one region (rest baseline, same k=κ/(1−|b|) map, no new constant), the ictal intensity SWEPT over {0.3,0.5,0.7,0.9} with every sign required to hold at every intensity. Four sign-only results, all CONFIRMED: F1 the containment/broadcast partition is DRIVE-INVARIANT — each focus is CONTAINED (self-localising, the ictal change concentrates at the focus, the seizure stays focal) or BROADCAST (relay, the change lands harder off-target, the seizure secondarily generalises), and the broadcast set {hippocampus, midbrain} is fixed at every intensity, so whether a focal seizure stays focal or generalises is a property of focus LOCATION (inheriting the E1.3 self/relay class); F2 broadcast IS off-target dominance — for a broadcast focus the mean off-target |Δc| exceeds its own (ratio>1, hippocampus ~4.2×, midbrain ~1.6×), the structural content of a seizure recruiting circuits BEYOND its focus, the equivalence holding at every intensity; F3 (the honest no-tuning result) off-target spread is NOT global hypersynchrony — the clean hypothesis ‘the broadcast foci are exactly the foci that drive the whole brain into the §25 over-sync state’ is FALSE: the single largest global-reach focus is the CEREBELLUM, which is CONTAINED, at every intensity, and the two broadcast foci move global R in OPPOSITE directions (midbrain RAISES toward over-sync, hippocampus LOWERS), so off-target spread and the §25 over-sync axis are TWO DISTINCT decoupled spatial properties and secondary-generalisation propagation is site-determined (the E1.4 lesson for epilepsy), the refuted clean hypothesis reported honestly; F4 the broadcast set is a COHERENT MINORITY relay-hub class — {hippocampus, midbrain} is simultaneously the E1.3 relay set and the off-target-dominant set, a strict minority (2 of 12, containment the structural default), and disjoint from the global-reach hub, so secondary generalisation is structurally the EXCEPTION carried by specific relay hubs (a [L] direction-only correspondence noted: most focal seizures stay focal, mesial-temporal/hippocampal foci are the paradigmatic secondarily-generalising epilepsy — never a patient-level prediction). A zero ictal drive reproduces the frozen M9 anchor R=0.38961455156 BIT-FOR-BIT and the off-state field equals baseline exactly (S5); engine imported READ-ONLY and byte-unchanged (0fbf4988…), SpatialField reused not re-derived, no new tuned constant. Registered as the 22nd atlas citizen (FOC-EPI-E1), reproduces bit-for-bit. FIREWALL absolute: a containment/broadcast class is a STRUCTURAL spatial quantity of the coupling model, NEVER the felt locus of a seizure and NOT a real electrode, EEG/SEEG localisation, current density, seizure-propagation map, a prediction of which seizures generalise, or surgical/resection guidance (Axis-A; consciousness_claim=0; hard problem OPEN); only structural signs and relations are asserted, every magnitude is [O]; nothing is a cure, a localisation, or a prognosis; efficacy=0; not medical advice.
